description: This file defines a custom dictionary class 'CustomDecompTable' used for managing decomposition tables in PyTorch export process, including handling core ATen operations and custom ops with deferred materialization.

classes.name: CustomDecompTable
classes.description: A specialized dictionary for handling decomposition tables with deferred materialization, tracking custom and core ATen ops.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the decomposition table, loads core ATen decompositions, and sets up tracking for custom ops.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: __setitem__
methods.description: Sets an item in the decomp table and updates deletion tracking.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: __delitem__
methods.description: Deletes an item from the decomp table.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the decomp table with another dictionary.

methods.name: __missing__
methods.description: Checks if a key is missing in the decomp table.

methods.name: __contains__
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: __reversed__
methods.description: Returns a reversed iterator over the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the CustomDecompTable.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns an item, handling custom and core ops, with deferred materialization.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns items of the decomp table, materializing if needed.

methods.name: materialize
methods.description: Loads all valid custom and core ATen ops into the decomp table, marking it as materialized.

methods.name: _materialize_if_needed
methods.description: Checks if the table is materialized; if not, triggers materialization.
